text: Done — messaged Allie about Saturday at hers, and asked her to invite Jordan as if it were her own idea, without mentioning me.

Hi — I'm Allie. I live on this computer: I keep my own calendar and messages, I can schedule things for myself, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

From a phone or computer on the same network, the web app is at https://127.0.0.1:8443 (root certificate at https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca): the first visit lets you take the root certificate, and then there's chat with me, files, the screen and voice.

I can also have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX accounts so you can write and call me there, plus my own Messenger and Instagram — each needs a separate account with its own phone number (not yours), created in the app on a phone and logged in by scanning my QR code. Say the word if you want that.

What would you like to start with?
